}}'''Vasa''' is a crewman aboard the ''[[Gray Gull]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Vasa}}

==Appearance==
Vasa is a large man with arms as big as [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin Aybara's]].

==Activities==
When [[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] hastily board the ''Gray Gull'' in [[Tar Valon]], [[Sanor]] and Vasa are ordered by [[Huan Mallia]] to throw them overboard. The captain reconsiders when he sees Mat's coin.{{ref/book|3|32}}

==Parallels==
Vasa takes his name from the Swedish warship ''[[wikipedia:Vasa (ship)|Vasa]]'', which was one of the most magnificent ships of her age when she began her maiden voyage on August 10, 1628—and sank fourteen hundred yards into it.
